title: AI engineer intern
description: Partial fit: honest about the gaps, strict about the evidence.
posting_text:
AI Engineer Intern - Lumen AI
You'll prototype LLM-powered features with our applied AI team.
Must have:
- Python
- Experience calling LLM APIs
- Understanding of AI agents and tool calling
Nice to have:
- RAG / vector databases

profile.name: Alex Example
profile.summary: Computer engineering student focused on backend and AI applications, with internship experience in QA and consulting.

bullets.text: Designed and executed functional test cases for a banking web application in an Agile team.
Tracked and triaged defects in Jira and validated data with SQL queries.
Built a FastAPI backend that scans the local network and serves device status to an HTML dashboard.
Runs as a background service with automatic restart.
Python scraper that finds flights under a price threshold and emails an HTML summary.
Scheduled weekly with GitHub Actions.

matches.note: Demonstrated Python proficiency through multiple projects and listed core skills.
Completed an AI Agents course covering LLMs, but lacks direct production or project experience calling LLM APIs.
Completed the Hugging Face AI Agents Course covering agent concepts.
Tool calling is specifically covered as part of the Hugging Face AI Agents Course.
No mention of RAG or retrieval-augmented generation in the profile.
No vector database knowledge or experience listed.

fit.summary: Alex meets the foundational Python and AI agent / tool calling knowledge requirements through projects and Hugging Face coursework, but has only partial hands-on LLM API experience and lacks evidence for RAG and vector databases.

summary.text: Computer engineering student with Python proficiency and training in AI agents, LLMs, and tool calling.

paragraphs.text: Lumen AI's focus on prototyping LLM-powered features matches my focus on backend and AI applications. Through the Hugging Face AI Agents Course, I gained a structured understanding of AI agents, tool calling, and LLMs.

I rely on Python for my software projects, including building a local network monitor with FastAPI and writing an automated flight scraper. These projects gave me direct practice developing Python services, managing data workflows, and automating tasks.
I have not worked with vector databases yet. As a computer engineering student with a strong Python foundation, I can support the applied AI team in building and testing new LLM prototypes.
